pairingEvidence: Pairing evidenced by shared efficiency columns: 'CTXM15R', '20R + 20R9', '25R + 25R9', '35R + 35R9', '42R + 42R', '50R + 50R', '60R + 60R', '71R + 71R' (page title C/FTXM-R + RXM-R(9)). CAVEAT: vertical merged band 'Combinaison multi uniquement' spans the efficiency table AND the outdoor-unit block -> these Perfera refs are for connection to MULTI-split outdoor groups; monosplit eligibility must be checked against the separate combination scheme (p.52). Never assume all R32 devices pair.

airflowUnitNote: p.43 publishes indoor 'Débit d'air' in m³/min (Silence/Bas/Moyen/Haut), NOT m³/h. Cooling and heating airflow are separate rows. Conversion to schema m3/h is x60 (1 m³/min = 60 m³/h); original published m³/min values/units retained in excerpts.
electricalInputNote: Puissance absorbée (electrical input) is published as Nom. only (single value), not min/nominal/max. Ratings store nominal only; min/max left null (not invented). Efficiency-table Puissance absorbée is complete-system; outdoor-only electrical boundary not separated -> unknown.
